verdict.rationale: Cua offers several programmatic surfaces of its own. The SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust creates and drives computers, Cua Driver works through MCP or a CLI, and agents can be followed from your own agent, the CLI or code. Desktop streaming is also exposed programmatically through media tickets. However, nothing in the evidence states that every UI action is available via API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or a full REST/OpenAPI reference; API coverage of UI-side functions such as Space sharing and roles, device approval, permissions, and vault approvals; independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
